Thanks Marissa — great call today. Quick recap from our side and a couple of clarifying questions: 

1) Success criteria we care about:
   - End-user latency median < 250ms (p95 target < 400ms) for our 1k token typical prompt
   - Semantic quality: top-1 answer relevance >= 85% on our evaluation set
   - Stable throughput to support 50 concurrent users during peak testing windows

2) Evaluation plan:
   - Week 1: integration and smoke tests with a 50-example test set we’ll share
   - Week 2-3: ramped scenario tests (search + summarization flows)
   - Final readout: live demo + pass/fail against the success criteria

Questions: who will own the evaluation harness on Redwood’s side (we can own runner infra but need an integration point)? Also can you confirm what model variant you’ll provision for the trial (quantized v.s. full precision)?

Appreciate the proposed timeline — Jenna and I are generally available the week of Aug 16 for kickoff.

—Sam
Senior Product Manager
Acme Industries

Thanks Sam — really appreciate the clear recap. Notes and answers below, plus a proposed mutual action plan attached.

1) Ownership:
   - Redwood: Neha (solutions engineer) will own integration support and the evaluation endpoint. Rishi (account lead) and I will manage timelines and commercial items.
   - Acme: Sam + Jenna to own test dataset and business success criteria sign-off.

2) Model variant & infra:
   - For the trial we’ll provision our quantized performance profile (rwd-q3) mapped to a 4-GPU Dedicated pool to hit your throughput targets while keeping latency low. If you want full-precision we can swap, but it will increase cost and may affect latency.

3) Proposed timeline (all dates in Pacific time):
   - Kickoff (45 mins) — Tue, Aug 17, 10:00am PT (suggested)
   - Week 1 (Aug 17–21): Integration + smoke tests (shared test set)
   - Week 2 (Aug 24–28): Scenario/ramped tests and quality evaluation
   - Final readout & decision — Fri, Sep 3, 9:00am PT

4) Success criteria (draft):
   - Latency: median < 250ms, p95 < 400ms on typical prompts
   - Relevance: top-1 >= 85% on Acme evaluation set
   - Stability: throughput sustained at 50 concurrent users for 30-minute window without >10% error rate

Next steps: please confirm (a) kickoff date/time, (b) owners for the test dataset and any VPN/network access we’ll need, and (c) whether you’re OK with the quantized profile. I attached a mutual action plan and our POC checklist — Neha will follow up with integration notes once kickoff is confirmed.

Thanks!
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
